services.name: Pontoon Saloon
services.desc: Join our outgoing dedicated team, significant income & career opportunities, and growth potential for those that love being on the water! Pontoon Saloon has a dedicated team that works together to deliver a premium experience in Nashville. With a passion for our customers, we set out to make their celebrations even more memorable. With many options for locals and tourists, we go above the bar to ensure a repeatable customer base that is always looking to come back! Crew members must be able to work in a fast-paced atmosphere, enjoy entertaining, be friendly and professional, and strive to provide an elite customer service experience all while upholding a high standard of rules and etiquette

services.name: All Cruises
services.desc: Enjoy a private river cruise aboard the new Pontoon Saloon II, equipped with custom upgrades that provide a unique experience through Nashville’s Riverfront. The Luxury Private Cruise is the perfect boat tour experience for all occasions, with capacity up to 47 guests (130 with multiple vessels). We offer a variety of beverage packages, catering options, and flexible cruise times during the week. The pontoon is equipped with bar seating, a catering table, and lounge seating along the open top bow, giving you options to enjoy the sun or shade. blurb: Guests cruise the Cumberland River on a pontoon boat with a bar-style party atmosphere including music, dancing, and games. Cruises include public party cruises, bachelorette/bachelor party cruises, private cruises, and corporate events. The boat features lounge seating, a bar, restroom, and a dance floor with views of the Nashville skyline.
